# Quick start

Install the command-line tool, then call `fetch()` with the [API docs](https://example.com/docs) open.

```bash
# install the tool
npm install --save my-tool
echo "hello world"
```
This paragraph follows the code block and must stay on its own line.

## Usage

- Run the server with **one** command
- Open the [dashboard](https://example.com/dash) in your browser
  - Nested items keep their indentation
1. Sign in with your account
2. Create your first project

> Tip: keep your API key secret.
